about.title: I'm Jacob, an IT tech out of Elkview, WV.
about.p1: Charleston is the bigger dot on the map. I work in that area.
about.p2: I like the moment someone who was stuck gets moving again. That's the part I stay for.
about.p3: Jobs, badges, and the email address each get their own stop. I won't make you read them three times.

northstar.seoTitle: NorthStar IT Services LLC · Jacob Wiseman
northstar.description: IT services, under my own name.
northstar.longDescription: NorthStar IT Services LLC is mine. I run it as an IT services business out of Elkview, working the Charleston area. The public site is northstarwv.com.
northstar.approach: It's a business, not a case study with a fake before-and-after. If you want the company, use the link. If you want me, use the email.
northstar.takeaway1: The name is NorthStar IT Services LLC. Not a technology brand I made up.
northstar.takeaway2: Home base is Elkview. The work reaches the Charleston area.
northstar.stackNote: I don't hang a tool list on the company. The work is IT services.
northstar.result: I'm the owner. That's the whole title.
northstar.seoDescription: I own NorthStar IT Services LLC, an IT services business in Elkview, West Virginia.

thomas-imaging.longDescription: I'm a Registration Specialist at WVU Medicine’s Thomas Imaging Center. The patients come in, and I register them. That registration runs in Epic.
thomas-imaging.approach: The job is the front of the visit: get the person checked in, in the system the center actually uses. I don't add other clinical systems to the story.
thomas-imaging.takeaway2: The place is WVU Medicine Thomas Imaging Center.
thomas-imaging.takeaway3: Epic is the system the registration runs in.
thomas-imaging.stackNote: Epic, for patient registration. That's the system I name.
thomas-imaging.result: It's the day job next to the business I own.
thomas-imaging.seoDescription: I'm a Registration Specialist at WVU Medicine Thomas Imaging Center. Patient registration runs in Epic.

comptia-a-plus.longDescription: I earned CompTIA A+ in October 2025. It expires in October 2028. The picture is CompTIA’s own organization badge, the one on their Credly page.
comptia-a-plus.approach: This is the credential I point at when the work is hardware, Windows, and the troubleshooting that happens at a desk.
comptia-a-plus.takeaway3: The badge links to CompTIA on Credly, not a personal share link.
comptia-a-plus.stackNote: Hardware, Windows, troubleshooting. That's the company it keeps.
comptia-a-plus.seoDescription: I earned CompTIA A+ in October 2025. It expires in October 2028.

network-plus.description: The one for the path between machines.
network-plus.longDescription: I earned CompTIA Network+ in October 2025. It expires in October 2028. Same official treatment: CompTIA’s organization badge on Credly.
network-plus.approach: When the problem leaves the desk and gets on a network, this is the credential that matches. Infrastructure, operations, troubleshooting.
network-plus.takeaway3: The badge is CompTIA’s organization page, not a personal share link.
network-plus.stackNote: Networking, TCP/IP, and Wi-Fi sit next to this one.
network-plus.seoDescription: I earned CompTIA Network+ in October 2025. It expires in October 2028.

csu-global.longDescription: I'm earning a B.S. in Information Technology at CSU Global. The date I'm aiming at is September 2027.

csu-global.takeaway2: The degree is a B.S. in Information Technology.

csu-global.result: Still going. September 2027 is the mark.
csu-global.seoDescription: I'm earning a B.S. in Information Technology at CSU Global, expected September 2027.
